name: r7-e1-fp16-rot3
author: solx-loop
description: In r6 each converter thread's release arrive (or bar.arrive) waited for the load it had just issued. Each 64-k block therefore cost one full load latency (about 800 ns), whatever the prefetch depth: ns-bound, which matches the portal/rented ratios of 1.16-1.27. Here the 24 converter warps form 3 rotating groups. Each group loads a whole 32 KB k-block slice, converts it and stores it, bar.syncs, and one lane does the release.cluster arrive. The group's next loads are issued only after the arrive,
